meta_description: Newcastle Plumbing & Heating Ltd offer expert plumbing and heating services across Newcastle. Fast response, honest pricing. Call 07939 332951 for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Newcastle's Trusted Plumbing & Heating
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns, leaks, or heating faults fixed fast — by experienced local engineers you can genuinely trust.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs and boiler installations to bathroom fitting and central heating repairs, we handle every job with care and expertise.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: We supply and fit energy-efficient boilers from leading manufacturers, ensuring your home stays warm and your energy bills stay manageable. All installations are carried out by Gas Safe registered engineers.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Regular servicing extends boiler life and keeps your warranty valid. Our engineers diagnose and repair faults quickly, getting your heating back up and running with minimal disruption.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: From full system installation to radiator replacements and power flushing, we keep your central heating performing at its best throughout the Newcastle winters.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, or sudden loss of hot water — we aim to reach you within 60 minutes across Newcastle and the surrounding areas. Don't let a small leak become a costly disaster.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: We fit full bathroom suites, shower enclosures, and wet rooms to a high standard, coordinating all plumbing work so your new bathroom is complete, leak-free, and ready to enjoy.

services.title: General Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Dripping taps, blocked drains, leaking pipes, and faulty stopcocks — no job is too small. We offer honest, upfront pricing and leave your home clean and tidy after every visit.

about_pullquote: We treat every home in Newcastle the same way we'd treat our own.
about_para_1: Newcastle Plumbing & Heating Ltd was established by local tradespeople who wanted to bring genuinely reliable, honest service to homeowners across Newcastle upon Tyne. Based in West Denton, we've spent years building a reputation across the city by consistently turning up on time, quoting fairly, and doing the job right first time. Every engineer on our team is fully qualified and Gas Safe registered.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our straightforward approach — no hidden charges, no upselling you don't need, and no disappearing act once the invoice is paid. Our customers return to us time and again because they know the advice they receive is honest and the workmanship is something they can rely on for years to come.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Called in the morning about a leaking pipe and the engineer was with us within the hour. Sorted quickly, no mess left behind, and the price was exactly as quoted. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Had my boiler serviced and a faulty radiator replaced. The engineer was polite, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain everything clearly. Refreshing to deal with a company that doesn't try to oversell you. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: David R.

reviews.text: Came out on a Saturday when our hot water stopped working completely. Had it fixed within an hour at a very fair price. Can't thank them enough — proper local tradespeople who actually care about the job they do.
reviews.author: Michelle H.
